players.name: CJ Carr
players.summary: Threw for 319 yards and three touchdowns in Notre Dame's 31-24 upset of No. 1 Miami on November 7.

players.name: Devon Dampier
players.summary: Passed for 177 yards and two touchdowns and rushed for 87 yards and two scores in Utah's 28-20 Holy War win over BYU on November 7.

players.name: Dylan Raiola
players.summary: Completed 25 of 40 for 257 yards and two touchdowns as Oregon rallied from 14-0 down to beat Ohio State 41-28 on November 7.

players.name: Dylan Riley
players.summary: Recorded 300 all-purpose yards in Boise State's 64-38 win over its November 7 opponent.

players.name: Steele Pizzella
players.summary: Threw for 432 yards and three touchdowns in his first start during Wake Forest's 77-0 win over Merrimack on November 7.

setup: No. 8 Texas (7–2) travels to No. 24 LSU (6–3) for a Saturday night SEC matchup in Baton Rouge. The Longhorns bring a three-game winning streak after Arch Manning threw three touchdowns in a 34–20 road victory at Missouri. LSU is looking for a response after falling 31–13 to Alabama. The matchup hinges on whether Texas can keep its passing rhythm against a motivated home side.

things.title: Manning's downfield rhythm
things.body: Manning completed 28 of 38 passes for 297 yards and three touchdowns at Missouri, with every touchdown covering more than 20 yards. In Texas' three-game winning streak he has 729 passing yards and seven touchdowns. LSU must limit explosive completions and make Texas earn long drives.

things.title: LSU's offensive response
things.body: The Tigers managed 13 points in their loss to Alabama. Facing a Texas offense that has been finishing drives with explosive passes, LSU needs steadier early-down production and sustained possessions rather than repeatedly asking its defense to defend a short field.

things.title: Turnovers and late-game execution
things.body: Manning threw six touchdowns without an interception in his last two games, including the go-ahead score late at Missouri. LSU's best chance to control the tempo is to create difficult passing downs and avoid the mistakes that let Texas finish drives quickly.

breakdown.bottom_line: Texas arrives with an increasingly efficient quarterback and timely explosive plays, while LSU has the environment and urgency to challenge that momentum. Sustained Tiger possessions, limiting Texas' downfield passes and fourth-quarter execution will determine the shape of this SEC showdown.
